name: Jump Start
description_short: Newark Academy's summer school readiness program in Livingston for children entering kindergarten, grade 1 or grade 2, 8:15 to 1 with lunch included. Mornings mix reading and math work with art, STEM, computers, PE and yoga; an optional afternoon Stay and Play adds games, water play and crafts.
refund_policy_summary: The $125 registration fee is not refundable. Full tuition refund for withdrawals by May 14; $250 fee May 15 to 31; 75% of tuition charged June 1 to 21; no refunds from June 22.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Junior Jump Start (rising K), Jump Start 1 and Jump Start 2: full session June 28 to August 6, $3,900; Session A June 28 to July 16, $1,950; Session B July 19 to August 6, $1,950; 8:15 to 1, lunch included. Stay and Play afternoon program: full session $1,550 or $775 per half; its half session dates on the page (June 22 to July 10, July 13 to 31) do not match the 2027 session and look left over from 2026. Ages derived from grades, not stated.

Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2027: full session June 28 to August 6 with Session A June 28 to July 16 and Session B July 19 to August 6. Registration currently closed. Address and phone from the Contact Us block.

Researched by Claude from this page. Academic, Enrichment and Jump Start run Monday June 28 to Friday August 6, no classes Monday July 5. Enrollment opens January 6, 2027; $25 early bird discount by April 30.

for_andrew: The candidate was the whole Newark Academy Summer Program (over 125 courses for K to 12, priced per course). I drafted only Jump Start (rising K to 2), the one program run like a day camp with set dates, hours and tuition. Andrew to decide whether the course program or the sports camps (Mott-Leeney Baseball, ages 5 to 13; tennis) should be listed too.
Stay and Play prices ($1,550 full, $775 per half) carry half session dates from June 22 to July 31 that don't fit the 2027 calendar, so they are left out of sessions.
